>if I came out, my social life would get Thanos snapped  
>friends gone  
>hallway whispers activated  
>public rejection speedrun any%  
>ostracized for the unforgivable crime of wanting to be cute and hold a boy’s hand  

>why does anyone care  
>why do they hate us for loving  
>that’s literally the most ironic villain arc possible  

>I like being a cute girly boy  
>what’s wrong with that

>mfw I just want boyfriend hand-holding privileges
